# Palakkad Tourism

> Palakkad Tourism is a comprehensive travel and information guide for Palakkad (Palghat), Kerala, India — covering tourist places, temples, churches, mosques, festivals, dams, rivers, heritage villages, and local directory listings.

Palakkad is known as the "Rice Bowl of Kerala" and is the third-largest district in Kerala, famous for the Palakkad Gap (Palakkad Pass) through the Western Ghats. The district has a unique blend of Malayali and Tamil cultures.

## Key Pages

- [Home](https://palakkadtourism.org/): Overview of Palakkad tourism with featured places and upcoming events.
- [Places to Visit](https://palakkadtourism.org/places.php): Complete list of tourist destinations in Palakkad.
- [History](https://palakkadtourism.org/history.php): Rich history from ancient dynasties (Pallava, Zamorin) through British rule to modern Kerala.
- [Palakkad Fort](https://palakkadtourism.org/fort.php): Tipu Sultan's fort, one of the best-preserved forts in Kerala.
- [Art & Culture](https://palakkadtourism.org/art-culture.php): Traditional arts, crafts, and cultural heritage of Palakkad.
- [Customs](https://palakkadtourism.org/customs.php): Local customs, traditions, and way of life.

## Religious Places

- [Temples](https://palakkadtourism.org/temples.php): Hindu temples in Palakkad — Kalpathy Ratholsavam temple, Nemmara Vela, and more.
- [Churches](https://palakkadtourism.org/churches.php): Christian churches across Palakkad district.
- [Mosques](https://palakkadtourism.org/mosques.php): Mosques and Islamic heritage in Palakkad.
- [Jain Temple](https://palakkadtourism.org/jain-temple.php): Jain temples in Palakkad.
- [Religious Places Overview](https://palakkadtourism.org/religious-places.php): Multi-faith religious sites.

## Dams & Water Bodies

- [Malampuzha Dam](https://palakkadtourism.org/dam-malampuzha.php): Largest dam in Kerala; inaugurated 1955 by Jawaharlal Nehru.
- [Parambikulam Dam](https://palakkadtourism.org/dam-parambikulam.php): Part of Parambikulam Wildlife Sanctuary.
- [Mangalam Dam](https://palakkadtourism.org/dam-mangalam.php)
- [Meenkara Dam](https://palakkadtourism.org/dam-meenkara.php)
- [Chulliyar Dam](https://palakkadtourism.org/dam-chulliyar.php)
- [Walayar Dam](https://palakkadtourism.org/dam-walayar.php)
- [Pothundy Dam](https://palakkadtourism.org/dam-pothundy.php)
- [Siruvani Dam](https://palakkadtourism.org/dam-siruvani.php): Supplies drinking water to Coimbatore.
- [Rivers](https://palakkadtourism.org/rivers.php): Bharathapuzha and other rivers of Palakkad.
- [Mountain Ranges & Passes](https://palakkadtourism.org/mountain-ranges-passes.php): Palakkad Gap and Western Ghats ranges.

## Festivals

- [Festivals](https://palakkadtourism.org/festivals.php): Onam, Kalpathy Ratholsavam, Nemmara Vela, Vishu, Christmas, Eid, and more.

## Institutions & Services

- [Institutions](https://palakkadtourism.org/institutions.php): Educational, government, and cultural institutions in Palakkad.
- [Hospitals](https://palakkadtourism.org/hospitals.php): Government, private, Ayurveda, and Homeopathy hospitals.
- [Heritage Villages](https://palakkadtourism.org/heritage-villages.php): Kalpathy, Thenkurissi, and other heritage villages.
- [How to Reach](https://palakkadtourism.org/how-to-reach.php): Train, bus, and road access to Palakkad.
